note: The default stdin and stdout paths, which is why the output is streamed rather than written to a temporary file and renamed. Signing to stdout emits gzip, and the runner decompresses before matching, so those expectations name the plain committed document.

cases.name: Inspect Compressed From Stdin
cases.note: Gzip detection works on a pipe, which cannot be seeked, so the magic has to be peeked and pushed back.

cases.name: Verify To Stdout With Incorrect Public Key
cases.note: Nothing reaches stdout, so a consumer downstream of the pipe sees an empty stream rather than an unverified document.

cases.name: Sign From Stdin To Stdout
cases.note: Signing needs the whole document hashed before the header can be written, which on a pipe means buffering it first.

cases.name: Sign Existing Signature From Stdin To Stdout
cases.note: The existing Ed25519 signature is kept and the RSA one added.

cases.name: Sign Text From Stdin To Stdout
cases.note: Inline seed text rather than a fixture, which is the other way an input reaches the tool.
